title: Affine morphism gives a quasi-coherent derived equivalence
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Regard $f_*\mathcal O_X$ as an $\mathcal O_Y$-algebra. Then $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] induces an equivalence $\Phi:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\simeq D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(f_*\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], where the target is the derived category of complexes of $f_*\mathcal O_X$-modules with quasi-coherent cohomology, and the composition of $\Phi$ with the restriction functor $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(f_*\mathcal O_X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ is $Rf_*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$.
